page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Marginal references in the left margin: "2. Pet. 3.9." beside the line "gelij converfi", and "Apoc. 14.6." beside the line "Babylonis excidium". Running head at top, page number at top left.

main_text.p: ræ fuæ, & illud quatenus fua juftitia patitur promovet:clamatque per Prophetam,convertimini.Convertimini ad me peccatores, quare moriemini? nō enim delectór morte morientis. Vivo ego dicit Dominus, nolo morte impij,fed utconvertatur impius à via fua & vivat. Expectat obfervatq; paternus Dei animus,ut ubi per prædicationē Evangelij 2. Pet. 3.9.converfi fuerint,misereatur eorum, & exaltetur parcens ipfis :nullos enim perire cupit, fed omnes ad pœnitentiam revertí, cunctofque falvari, & ad cognitionem veritatis pervenire. Quum is defideret eorum falutem, in cujus manu eft falvare, ipfeque eis cognitionem veritatis optet, qui folus fcientiam falutarem falvandis confert? quis dubitarit, cum plurimorum falute fuum fe Evangelij præconium[?] inftitutum ? præfertim ubi considerarit[?] horam jam & tempus advenifle , quo falcem in paratam hujus agri meffim immittere deceat : jam enim beftiæ plaga fanatur ; & quod ejus fanationem fequetur,Babylonis Apoc. 14.6.excidium, expectatur : nos autem medium inter hæc duo quod interjacet tempus occupamus:eo fecundum Apocalypfeos ordinem Angelus per medium cæli volabit, habens Evangelium æternum, ut Evangelizet incolis terræ,& omni genti & tribui & lin-

page.notes: Printed page number and running head read with some doubt. "delectór", "præconium" and "considerarit" are uncertain readings. Marginal references are transcribed as printed. The first word is a fragment continued from the previous page.
